verdict.rationale: Pinecone has no documented sandbox or dev/test environment. Its docs do say serverless index backups can be used to 'copy indexes, or experiment with configurations', which lets you test on a copy rather than the live index. API key permissions and RBAC could help keep test access away from production resources, but the docs don't frame them as environment isolation. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, documented project-level separation of dev and production, guidance on using test API keys against isolated data, independent or hands-on confirmation of a sandbox testing workflow.
